points.label: Scene and saying
points.left: Melchizedek brings bread and wine, blesses Abram, and receives a tenth; the king of Sodom then makes a different request, which Abram refuses.
points.right: The LORD addresses the psalmist’s Lord, promises rule, swears an unchanging oath, and names a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: The psalm speaks of a priest forever in Melchizedek’s order

payload.tension: One source narrates Melchizedek as a person; the other uses his name to identify a priestly order.
payload.title: A person in Genesis and an order in the psalm
